facts.claim: In 1877-8, the earthwork between Bangalore and Channapatna was started as a relief work.
facts.quote: In 1877-8 the earthwork between Bangalore and Channapatna was commenced as a relief work.

facts.claim: The section from Bangalore to Channapatna, spanning 35 miles, was opened to traffic on the 1st of February 1881.
facts.quote: The section from Bangalore to Channapatna, 35 miles, was opened to traffic on the ist February 1881

facts.claim: During two months, 20749 passengers traveled by the line, and the total earnings reached Rs. 13219.
facts.quote: In these two months 20,749 passengers travelled by the line and the total earnings were Rs. 13,219.
